name: GEO for AI Lite – Generative Engine Optimization
author: Paul Huizinga

sections.description:
GEO for AI Lite helps your WordPress site get discovered by AI systems like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google’s AI Overviews.

As AI becomes the new way people find information, your website needs more than traditional SEO. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) — also known as AI SEO or SEO for AI — ensures your content gets cited in AI-generated answers. This free plugin gives you the essential tools to get started.

🎯 What is GEO (SEO for AI)?

Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is the next step beyond traditional SEO. While SEO optimizes for search engines, GEO optimizes for AI systems. When someone asks ChatGPT a question, will your content be part of the answer?

✨ Free Features

🔍 AI Audit Tool
Get a complete analysis of your website’s AI-readiness. The audit checks 22 factors and shows you exactly what to improve.

📝 AI Meta Tags
Add AI-specific descriptions and topics to your homepage, posts, and pages. Help AI systems understand what your content is about.

📄 Automatic llms.txt
Automatically generates an llms.txt file with guidelines for Large Language Models. Tells AI systems how they may use your content.

🤖 AI Permissions
Control whether AI systems may:
– Access and scrape your content
– Use your content for model training

🔗 Robots.txt Integration
Automatically adds AI policy references to your robots.txt file so AI crawlers can find your guidelines.

🚀 Upgrade to Pro

Need more power? GEO for AI Pro includes everything in Lite, plus:

📄 Advanced Policy Files
– ai.txt with granular AI permissions
– Image training controls
– Text training controls
– Voice training controls
– Attribution requirements

🏢 Business Schema
Complete LocalBusiness/Organization structured data for AI systems:
– Company details & contact info
– Address & coordinates
– Opening hours
– Logo & branding

❓ FAQ System
Create AI-optimized FAQs that get cited in AI responses:
– Custom post type for easy management
– Organize FAQs in groups
– Gutenberg block & shortcode
– Customizable styling
– Automatic FAQPage schema

📊 Additional Schema
– Article schema for blog posts
– Product schema for WooCommerce

Get GEO for AI Pro →

🤖 Supported AI Systems

GEO for AI helps you get discovered by:
– ChatGPT & OpenAI
– Claude & Anthropic
– Google Gemini & AI Overviews
– Perplexity AI
– Microsoft Copilot
– And other LLM-based systems

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/geo-for-ai-lite/ or install via the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to GEO for AI (Lite) in your admin menu.
  4. Run the AI Audit to see your current AI-readiness score.
  5. Configure your AI permissions (training & scraping).
  6. Add AI descriptions and topics to your homepage.
  7. Add AI meta tags to your important posts and pages.
sections.faq:
What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)?

GEO is the practice of optimizing your website to be discovered and cited by AI systems like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity. As more people use AI assistants to find information, GEO ensures your content is part of their answers. GEO is often referred to as AI SEO or SEO for AI.

Is this an SEO for AI plugin?

Yes! GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) is what many people call SEO for AI. Just like traditional SEO helps your site rank in Google, this plugin helps your content get discovered and cited by AI systems like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity.

How is this different from traditional SEO?

Traditional SEO focuses on ranking in search engine results. GEO focuses on being included in AI-generated responses. Both are important – GEO for AI complements your existing SEO plugins like Yoast or RankMath.

What is an llms.txt file?

Similar to how robots.txt communicates with search engine crawlers, llms.txt communicates with AI crawlers. It tells Large Language Models how they may use your content.

Will this affect my Google rankings?

No negative impact. The meta tags and structured guidelines can actually complement your SEO efforts.

Can I control what AI systems learn from my content?

Yes! GEO for AI Lite lets you control scraping and training permissions. For more granular control (image/text/voice training, attribution), upgrade to Pro.

What’s the difference between Lite and Pro?

Lite includes: AI Audit, AI meta tags, llms.txt, basic permissions, robots.txt integration.

Pro adds: ai.txt file, business schema, FAQ system with schema, granular AI permissions (image/text/voice training, attribution), article schema, product schema.

Do I need technical knowledge?

No. The plugin is beginner-friendly. The AI Audit tells you exactly what to improve, and all settings have clear descriptions.
